## About
Texas Best Transmission is a Christian, family owned and operated shop on Sturgeon Ct. in Arlington. Robert Clark owns the company and is involved with the day-to-day operations to make sure the work is done right.
Whether you have an automatic, standard, or computerized transmission, we can take on your toughest transmission problems. Foreign or domestic, new or old, gas or diesel, we work on cars, trucks, SUV's, and vans.
Our business is built on word of mouth from satisfied customers, and we hold a 4.5 rating from 85 Google reviews. We serve Arlington and Mansfield.

## Services
- Transmission rebuilds: We rebuild automatic and standard transmissions, foreign or domestic.
- Transmission replacements: When a rebuild isn't the right call, we replace the transmission.
- Transmission adjustments: Adjustments for transmissions that aren't shifting the way they should.
- Standard Transmission: Manual transmission repair and rebuilds.
- Clutches, Fly Wheels, & Axles: Clutch, flywheel and axle repair.
- Differential work: We fix all differential problems and issues.
- Drive shafts: Drive shaft repair.
- 4 X 4 Transfer Cases: New transfer cases for your 4-wheel drive vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to look at my transmission?
A: No. Diagnostic tests are free, and so are transmission performance road tests and checks. We use computer equipment to pinpoint what's wrong.

Q: Will you work with my extended warranty?
A: We work with most extended warranty companies. Call us and we'll talk it through.

Q: My car won't move. Can you tow it?
A: Yes, towing is available. Call 817-790-0100.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
